title: Tor-independent scalar extension of a resolution of an A-K-flat complex
statement: Let R,A,B be commutative rings with R-algebra structures on A and B. Suppose Tor_i^R(A,B)=0 for every i>0 [def-weil-pbc-tor-modules]. Let Q be any cochain complex of A-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules], K-flat over A [def-pc-module-kflat-complex]. Let P be an R-K-flat complex and s:P -> Q restricted to R any quasi-isomorphism [def-pc-quasi-iso-modules]. Then termwise scalar extension along R -> B [def-weil-module-base-change] sends s to a quasi-isomorphism of B-complexes. There is no boundedness assumption on P or Q, no flatness assumption on A or B, and no final coefficient algebra or cohomology model.

source.place: Section 06Y5 and Tag 06Y6, lemma-derived-base-change; Tag 08IB, lemma-compare-base-change, final affine Tor calculation. Official Stacks pages read online because this clone omits the source files.

proof.text: Construct functorial flat covers using the rank-one free module as a flat separator, the copower adjunction counit, and closure of flat objects under coproducts. The source K-flat left derivability structure then supplies an actual R-K-flat resolution f:F -> B[0]. This uses only proved source constructions.

Apply the tensor augmentation lemma to Q, obtaining that Q restricted to R tensor f is a quasi-isomorphism. K-flatness of P gives P tensor f a quasi-isomorphism, and K-flatness of F gives s tensor F a quasi-isomorphism. The whisker-exchange equation identifies the two composites around the tensor square. Two-out-of-three proves s tensor B[0] is a quasi-isomorphism.

Identify tensoring on the right with B[0] with termwise tensoring with B by map₂HomologicalComplexFlipObjSingleIso. The explicitly proved natural coefficient isomorphism swaps m tensor b to b tensor m and identifies the result with scalar extension followed by restriction. Lift it to complexes, transfer quasi-isomorphism using Arrow.isoMk and naturality, and reflect it through exact restriction of scalars.

lean.statement:
theorem scalarExtension_quasiIso_of_torIndependent_kFlat
    {R A B : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B]
    (hTor : ∀ i : ℕ, 0 < i →
      IsZero (((CategoryTheory.Tor' (ModuleCat.{u} R) i).obj (ModuleCat.of R A)).obj
        (ModuleCat.of R B)))
    (Q : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ)
    (hK : ∀ L : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ, L.Acyclic →
      (CochainComplex.mapBifunctor L Q (MonoidalCategory.curriedTensor _)).Acyclic)
    (P : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℤ)
    (hP : (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso (ModuleCat.{u} R) (.up ℤ)).kFlat P)
    (s : P ⟶ (((restrictScalars (algebraMap R A)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q))
    (hs : QuasiIso s) :
    QuasiIso (((extendScalars (algebraMap R B)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map s)
